say:6:1623211004:1.text: We've got two suspicious-looking ones prowling the outskirts. Everyone's all feathers and tails!

say:8:1623211005:1.text: Magical creations... You mean, those brooms that whizz around a mage's house, and candles that burn forever?
say:8:1623211005:1.source_cn: 魔法造物……是那些会在魔法师屋子里飞来飞去的扫把和永远...

say:9:1623211006:0.text: So they can think? What if they snap and start slinging magic at us?
say:9:1623211006:0.source_cn: 他们真的有自己的想法吗？会不会突然失控，用魔法打我们呀？
say:9:1623211006:0.male: So they can think? What if they snap and start slinging magic at us?
say:9:1623211006:0.female: So they can think? What if they snap and start slinging magic at us?

say:13:1623211008:0.text: Well, as long as they're not up to something. I've got kids to mind. We don't want strangers poking around our nest!
say:13:1623211008:0.source_cn: 只要不是什么可疑的家伙就行，我和我的孩子们个不希望被打扰！
say:13:1623211008:0.male: Well, as long as they're not up to something. I've got kids to mind. We don't want strangers poking around our nest!
say:13:1623211008:0.female: Well, as long as they're not up to something. I've got kids to mind. We don't want strangers poking around our nest!

say:14:1623211009:1.text: Yeah... They're still babies. We can't take risks.
say:14:1623211009:1.source_cn: 是的……毕竟我们的孩子都还小。
say:14:1623211009:1.male: Yeah... They're still babies. We can't take risks.
say:14:1623211009:1.female: Yeah... They're still babies. We can't take risks.

say:16:1623211010:0.source_cn: 所以，他们靠近森林是要做什么呢？

choice_prompt:17:1623211010.source_cn: 所以，他们靠近森林是要做什么呢？

say:18:1623211011:1.text: But... we've only heard of magical creations. Meeting 'em for real is tail-flicking scary.
say:18:1623211011:1.source_cn: 但是……大家只是听说过魔法造物，第一次接触还挺紧张的。
say:18:1623211011:1.male: But... we've only heard of magical creations. Meeting 'em for real is tail-flicking scary.
say:18:1623211011:1.female: But... we've only heard of magical creations. Meeting 'em for real is tail-flicking scary.

say:19:1623211012:1.text: Maybe we should give them a chance? They don't sound evil to me.
say:19:1623211012:1.source_cn: 所以我们要不要试着给他们一些机会，也许他们真的没有恶意？
say:19:1623211012:1.male: Maybe we should give them a chance? They don't sound evil to me.
say:19:1623211012:1.female: Maybe we should give them a chance? They don't sound evil to me.

say:22:1623211014:0.text: We could try... but who's going first? You? Him? Well, don't look at me. No, no, no!
say:22:1623211014:0.source_cn: 试试看……但谁敢先靠近？你？他？不，可别让我去。
say:22:1623211014:0.male: We could try... but who's going first? You? Him? Well, don't look at me. No, no, no!
say:22:1623211014:0.female: We could try... but who's going first? You? Him? Well, don't look at me. No, no, no!

say:24:1623211015:1.text: Um... what if they suddenly go crazy? I-I'm still a little scared...
say:24:1623211015:1.source_cn: 嗯……要是他们忽然发疯怎么办？我、我还是有点怕。
say:24:1623211015:1.male: Um... what if they suddenly go crazy? I-I'm still a little scared...
say:24:1623211015:1.female: Um... what if they suddenly go crazy? I-I'm still a little scared...

say:25:1623211016:1.text: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.
say:25:1623211016:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人……如果你也常来看看，我们就不会那么害怕了。
say:25:1623211016:1.male: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.
say:25:1623211016:1.female: Magister... It would help if you could check in on us from time to time.

say:28:1623211018:1.text: Hmm... In that case, I guess I can't complain.
say:28:1623211018:1.source_cn: 唔……既然魔法师大人这样答应了，我也没什么好说的。
say:28:1623211018:1.male: Hmm... In that case, I guess I can't complain.
say:28:1623211018:1.female: Hmm... In that case, I guess I can't complain.

say:29:1623211019:1.text: Alright. Who knows. This might actually make things interesting.

say:30:1623211020:1.text: So do swing by more often. Take a walk... and maybe keep an eye on those two new neighbors for the woods.

say:30:1623211020:1.female: So do swing by more often. Take a walk... and maybe keep an eye on those two new neighbors for the woods.
